notes: Document is a DOE final technical report (Rice University, award DE-FC36-05GO15080), not a review, perspective, thesis, patent or abstract without data, so not_primary was not applied; most of the report is computational (GCMC, DFT). The only measured H2 uptake values are the Fig. 10 surface-excess isotherms (77 K and 87 K, to about 26 bar fluorinated and 35 bar pristine) for MSC-30 fluorinated at Rice and pristine MSC-30, measured by the Center partner Caltech ('Adsorption data provided by Channing Ahn, Caltech'; samples 'returned to Cal Tech for evaluation', p. 10). I treated this as the project's own multi-laboratory measurement, not uptake quoted from other work, since no earlier publication is cited for it; this is the main judgement call. The uptake method (gravimetric or volumetric) is not named. The NREL/Air Products tests on fluorinated nanotube salts are reported without values. The report does not say that the Fig. 10 data were published before, so duplicate_data was not applied. The HiPco SWNT surface area ('of the order of 1500 m2/gram', p. 8) has no uptake value attached.
